completed_items.description: Added apiKeyHash column (nullable, unique-indexed) to project entity for API key lookup. Server-only field using SHA-256 hash — not added to shared Project type.

Implemented POST /v1/authentication/team-login endpoint: hashes API key with SHA-256, finds project by hash, verifies email via user-identity lookup, checks project membership, returns JWT. Added findByApiKeyHash to project-service.

Removed old sign-up, sign-in, switch-platform, and federated-auth endpoints from controller and service. Stripped authentication.service.ts to team-login only. Updated dev-seeds.ts to no-op (CLI scripts handle team creation). Replaced old auth tests with placeholder.

Created create-team CLI script at packages/server/api/src/app/cli/create-team.ts. Accepts --name and --owner-email args, creates platform/identity/user/project with API key hash, prints API key to stdout.

Created add-member CLI script at packages/server/api/src/app/cli/add-member.ts. Accepts --project-id and --email, finds/creates user-identity+user, creates default MEMBER project_role, inserts project_member row for team access.
Created rotate-key CLI script at packages/server/api/src/app/cli/rotate-key.ts. Accepts --project-id, generates new API key, updates apiKeyHash, prints new key to stdout.
Added email, firstName, lastName columns to user entity and shared User zod type. Updated CreateParams in user-service, test mock helpers to populate these fields. Prepares for user-identity removal.

Updated access-token-manager assertUserSession to use user.verified/tokenVersion directly instead of fetching user-identity. Removed userIdentityService import from access-token-manager.

Updated teamLogin and getProjectAndToken to use user fields directly instead of user-identity. Added getOneByPlatformAndEmail to user-service.
